claim: 8 terrorist bombs dropped in Jammu and Kashmir on 1st February 2026

traces.text: Indian defence authorities and state police confirm zero aerial bomb drops or major explosions occurred in Jammu and Kashmir on February 1, 2026. Claims of 8 bombs circulating on social media are unverified and false.
Independent monitors in Srinagar reported no artillery or aerial ordnance explosions across the Kashmir valley on February 1. Regional normalcy was observed with routine security operations.
PIB Fact Check and official state releases refuted viral reports alleging 8 bombs were dropped in J&K, confirming the social media narrative is fabricated disinformation.
